brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Kilnroom, the online shop in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: handmade and warm but not rustic or folksy; no pottery wheels, no vase or mug silhouettes, no flames. It must work on a shipping label, a tissue-paper sticker and Instagram. Web and social only; customers in Turkey and Europe.

claim.notes: Üç yön de iki sketch turunda eleştirmenden 'none' aldı (stok kemer/K/UI-karo okumaları), hiçbir kavram geliştirilmedi, kapıyı geçen olmadı; bu yüzden finalize, export, install-assets ve galeri yapılmadı.

concepts.title: One of the Batch
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 glossy bean/egg/pebble; s2 arched door or tombstone icon; s3 stacked bowls, burger-like layers; s4 basket or cat face with drips. s2 is a door/tombstone (a risk to name is a strike), s3 is the product's own object, s1 is a stock blob (80% similarity), s4 muddy. Try one ownable form that carries the idea of one-of-a-batch without a door or vessel.

concepts.title: Hinged K
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 K in a tilted square (K app/Kik-like tile); s2 slanted-cut K; s3 wobbly K; s4 K with a dot (K. wordmark). Every sketch is the plain initial with a cut, offset or dot; no hinge idea survives. Stock K similarity is also high. Drop the letter, or find a form where the hinge or the clay cut is the whole mark.

concepts.title: Threshold
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s1 postage stamp with a hole (stamp icon/cookie); s2 K app icon in a notched square; s3 bucket/card with drips; s4 star or cookie with a dash; s5 hamburger/stack bars. All struck: s2 is the initial with a cut and a UI tile, s5 is a menu icon at 16px, s1 is a known stamp object. Try a non-letter, non-object idea with one unexpected, hand-made silhouette.
